channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Coastal Flood Statement · Kenedy Island, Willacy Island, Cameron Island
item.description: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 2 at 10:58AM CDT until October 3 at 6:00AM CDT by NWS Brownsville TX. In effect until Oct 3, 6:00 AM CT. Areas: Kenedy Island, Willacy Island, Cameron Island. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
